description: Buy a timestamped FreshProof observation of a public HTTP/HTTPS URL. Returns final URL, observation timestamp, age, HTTP status, SHA-256 body hash, body size, ETag, Last-Modified, fetch duration, and whether the observation came from shared cache or a fresh public-network request. Set max_age=0 when a new public-network request is required. The response body itself is not returned.

max_age.description: Maximum acceptable observation age in seconds. Defaults to 300. Set to 0 to force a fresh public-network request.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL to observe

name: observe_url
